command.description: The shell command, run non-interactively with bash -c in the workspace root.

description.description: What the command does, in at most 200 characters; the user sees it while the command runs.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds the command runs in the foreground; default 120, at most 600. A command still running then continues in the background as a task.

run_in_background.description: Start the command as a background task and return its task ID at once, for a server, a long build or test run you keep working beside.
